decks.name: LeetCode #875 - Koko Eating Bananas
decks.description: Find minimum eating speed to finish all banana piles within given hours

cards.question: Koko Eating Bananas: Koko loves to eat bananas. There are n piles of bananas, the ith pile has piles[i] bananas. The guards have gone and will come back in h hours. Koko can decide her bananas-per-hour eating speed of k. Each hour, she chooses some pile of bananas and eats k bananas from that pile. If the pile has less than k bananas, she eats all of them instead and will not eat any more bananas during this hour. Koko likes to eat slowly but still wants to finish eating all the bananas before the guards return. Return the minimum integer k such that she can eat all the bananas within h hours.

solutions.name: Binary Search
solutions.explanation: Use binary search on the possible eating speeds from 1 to max pile size. For each speed, calculate total hours needed. If feasible within h hours, try smaller speed. Otherwise, increase speed. Optimal approach avoiding linear search.

solutions.timeDescription: Binary search on speed range log m iterations, each checking n piles where m is max pile size
solutions.spaceDescription: Constant space using only variables for search pointers and time calculation
solutions.exampleWalkthrough: Given piles=[3,6,7,11] and h=8: Max=11, search range [1,11]. Try k=6: hours = ceil(3/6)+ceil(6/6)+ceil(7/6)+ceil(11/6) = 1+1+2+2 = 6 <= 8, feasible. Try k=3: hours = 1+2+3+4 = 10 > 8, not feasible. Try k=4: hours = 1+2+2+3 = 8 <= 8, feasible. Answer is 4.

solutions.name: Brute Force
solutions.explanation: Try every eating speed starting from 1 and incrementing until finding the first speed that allows finishing within h hours. Simple but inefficient as it checks each speed linearly.
